Minimum Qualifications defaults to required; Preferred Qualifications makes its items nice_to_have. Technologies named only in Responsibilities or company information are excluded.
NLP leaves alternative group 1 because multilingual NLP is independently requested in Preferred Qualifications; its required minimum-qualification mention determines the collapsed label.
Multilingual NLP maps to nlp. The multimodal tasks are read literally as techniques within the requested experience and are unmapped where no taxonomy entry fits.
E-commerce policies, dispute resolution workflows, and merchant-buyer interactions are excluded as domain knowledge. Degree fields are not skill requirements.
